About Phi Partners

Phi Partners is the a market leader for capital markets technology services providing technology & quant services, solutions, and expertise to buy-side and sell-side financial institutions including some of the world’s largest investment banks, hedge funds and asset management firms. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in London, Phi has a presence in all major continents. Our niche focus on Front Office Technology has been a differentiator and gateway into the world’s best financial institutions.

About Phi Partners Brazil

Phi Partners has nearshore Centres-of-Excellence which are specialized in respective ‘Lines of Business’ (LoBs). Our latest São Paulo Centre-of-Excellence, houses our Quant, Front Office & Risk Technology Services (FORTS) & Murex teams. The São Paulo Centre-of-Excellence was opened with the goal to strengthened Phi's current relationship with our North America clients, as well with global clients with presence in São Paulo. Joining us means diving into truly groundbreaking work, pushing the limits of what modern technology can deliver while solving high-impact challenges for top-tier clients. You’ll build cutting-edge solutions for the world’s largest Investment Banks, leading Asset Managers, and market-defining Hedge Funds, working on projects where innovation is not an extra, but a fundamental expectation in everything we deliver.

About The FORTS Practice

Phi Partners is one of the largest consultancies specializing FORTS, with a dedicated team of over 175 consultants spread across multiple locations. Our team is distinguished by deep expertise in front-office and risk technology solutions, empowering top-tier financial institutions to optimize their trading and risk management capabilities.

At Phi Partners, we are committed to a collaborative, high-performance culture where professionals work together to deliver complex front-office solutions to elite clients. We specialize in the end-to-end implementation of front-office and risk platforms, from initial requirements gathering to post-go-live support, ensuring that our clients are fully supported throughout the platform lifecycle. We focus on custom development and configuration, creating solutions that address unique client needs and regulatory requirements in real-time trading and risk management.

Key Responsibilities

Phi is seeking an experienced an Engineering Manager / Technology Lead to establish and run a local delivery team in São Paulo working on a modern, cloud-native, cross-asset Pricing & Risk platform for a global financial-services client.

This role owns local delivery, team leadership, governance, and quality , allowing the global technical lead to focus on architecture and strategy. The successful candidate will be hands-on, delivery-oriented, and business-aware , with a strong Python-led engineering mindset and experience building and operating distributed systems in regulated environments.

This role gives you the opportunity to:

• Report directly to the Global Engineering & Technology Lead based in London

• Lead the São Paulo delivery team

• Own end-to-end delivery for the São Paulo team across development, testing, release, and BAU support

• Translate high-level architectural direction into practical, incremental delivery plans

• Ensure delivery against agreed milestones, quality standards, and non-functional requirements

• Act as the local point of accountability for delivery outcomes

• Own engineering governance , including:

• Code quality and review practices

• Testing strategy and coverage

• CI/CD and release discipline

• Documentation and operational readiness

• Ensure solutions meet security, resilience, and auditability expectations typical of Pricing & Risk systems

• Proactively identify and mitigate delivery and operational risks

• Remain technically engaged , contributing where appropriate (design reviews, complex debugging, critical path work)

• Act as a trusted local interface to client technology and business stakeholders

The Ideal candidate

Essential

• Proven experience as an Engineering Manager, Technology Lead , or similar role

• Strong hands-on engineering background, ideally with Python as a primary language

• Experience leading small to mid-sized development teams in a delivery-focused environment

• Demonstrated ownership of delivery, quality, and governance , not just design

• Experience building or operating cloud-native platforms

• Strong communication skills and confidence engaging with business and technical stakeholders

• Fluent English (spoken and written)

Highly Desirable

• Experience in capital markets, pricing, risk, trading, or market data systems

• Prior experience working with distributed or international teams

• Background in regulated or high-reliability environment

• Exposure to cross-asset systems or analytics platforms

Why should you join Phi Parnters

Join us as we build the next-generation team, an ambitious, fast-growing group delivering world-class, complex, and genuinely exciting projects to major financial institutions around the globe. We’re in a pivotal expansion phase, working with leading-edge technologies and giving you the chance to shape our strategy, influence key architectural decisions, and deploy solutions that truly impact global Capital Markets. This is a rare opportunity to be part of a world-leading Capital Markets Technology Consultancy while working alongside one of the strongest banking organizations in the industry.

title: Information Technology Portfolio Manager
description:
Job Title: IT Portfolio Manager

Job Type: 12-Month Contract

Job Location: Tampa, FL (Remote)

Role Summary

The Delivery Portfolio Manager is accountable for the end-to-end performance of a portfolio of delivery initiatives (digital, operational, or transformation), ensuring they are strategically aligned, properly funded, forecasted, governed, and executed. This role sits at the intersection of delivery leadership and financial management; owning portfolio-level budgeting, forecasting, variance management, investment governance, and benefits tracking while providing leaders with decision-ready transparency on what our customer is getting for its investment.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Strategy, Intake & Prioritization

  • Translate our client’s business priorities into a coherent portfolio roadmap and sequencing plan across initiatives and value streams.
  • Operate a structured intake/demand process that connects ideas to funded work with clear outcomes and sponsors.
  • Facilitate prioritization using value, risk, compliance, capacity, and funding constraints; recommend start/stop/continue actions.

Financial Management & Investment Governance (Core of Role)

  • Own portfolio financials across CAPEX/OPEX (and where applicable, capitalization policy alignment), including annual planning and rolling reforecasting.
  • Maintain a portfolio financial “system of truth,” including budget vs. actuals, burn rate, run vs. change, and forecast accuracy.
  • Perform variance root cause analysis and surface financial risks (scope creep, vendor overrun, dependency delays) with mitigation options.
  • Support governance rhythms (e.g., Quarterly Planning Events) ensuring initiatives have clear lean business cases, cost drivers, measurable outcomes, and owners.
  • Partner with Finance, Procurement, and initiative leaders to enforce controls, transparency, and compliance expectations consistent with our customer’s integrity and records standards.

Delivery Oversight & Portfolio Health

  • Provide portfolio-level oversight across multiple teams, tracking delivery confidence, milestones, dependencies, risks, quality, and readiness to deploy.
  • Establish lightweight governance that improves throughput and decision velocity, without slowing delivery.
  • Drive early escalation with clear options and tradeoffs across scope, schedule, cost, and quality.

Capacity, Resource & Portfolio Planning

  • Build portfolio capacity plans aligned to demand, proactively surface bottlenecks and cost impacts.
  • Ensure vendor investments align to portfolio outcomes, budgets, and controls in our customer’s global operating context.

Benefits Realization & Value Tracking

  • Define value measures for initiatives (OKRs/KPIs) and establish baselines, track benefits delivery and realization over time.
  • Make benefits visible post-delivery—identify drift between expected and realized outcomes and drive corrective action.

Reporting & Transparency

  • Deliver crisp, decision-ready reporting on portfolio performance (delivery + financial), top risks/dependencies, and investment tradeoffs with recommendations.
  • Build trust through “no surprises” reporting aligned to our customer’s culture of integrity and responsible stewardship.
  • Safety, Risk & Integrity
  • Ensure portfolio governance respects our customer’s expectations for health, safety, ethical conduct, and accurate records.
  • Promote a speak-up culture and proactively manage delivery risks that could impact operational integrity, compliance, or stakeholder trust.

Required Qualifications

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in IT portfolio delivery management with direct accountability for budgeting, forecasting, and investment governance.
  • Demonstrated strength in financial modeling, variance analysis, and forecasting.
  • Experience operating in a large organization with global stakeholders and multiple business segments.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and portfolio reporting (Power BI strongly preferred).
  • Experience working with Agile, Scrum, and Kanban

title: Consultor de Vendas Pleno - Off Trade São Paulo
description:
Sobre Nós (A Cultura Zahil)

Somos uma referência consolidada de 39 anos no mercado brasileiro na importação e distribuição de vinhos. Nosso portfólio possui mais de 400 rótulos de 70 produtores de 15 países, presentes em mais de 4.000 pontos de venda em todo o país. Acreditamos que o vinho é capaz de conectar pessoas e criar momentos únicos.

O Perfil que Buscamos

Você é uma pessoa naturalmente curiosa e orientada a resultados , que enxerga cada negócio como uma oportunidade de construir uma parceria duradoura. Tem a maturidade para trabalhar com autonomia , gerir sua carteira de clientes e a criatividade para inovar dentro de um ambiente que valoriza tanto a tradição quanto a evolução.

Características que nos inspiram:

  • Mentalidade analítica: Usa dados para fundamentar decisões criativas e montar cartas de vinho estratégicas.
  • Visão estratégica: Enxerga o panorama completo (cliente, mercado, concorrência) antes de agir.
  • Adaptabilidade: Aprende rapidamente e se reinventa conforme as necessidades do mercado e dos clientes.
  • Proatividade: Antecipa necessidades (do restaurante, do hotel) e propõe soluções de portfólio e serviço.
  • Resiliência: Transforma os desafios da negociação e do dia a dia em oportunidades de crescimento.

Descrição do Cargo

O(A) Consultor(a) de Vendas Off-Trade é uma peça-chave na estratégia da Zahil em São Paulo. Ele(a) é responsável por construir e gerenciar relacionamentos com os principais mercados e lojas da cidade.

A função exige uma prospecção ativa e uma gestão de carteira inteligente, é preciso agilidade para navegar no dinâmico mercado de São Paulo. Flexibilidade, capacidade de improvisação e vontade de aprender constantemente. O objetivo é ser um parceiro estratégico para o cliente garantindo visibilidade e o crescimento mútuo.

Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar uma carteira de clientes Off-Trade em São Paulo, fortalecendo o relacionamento e identificando oportunidades.
  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com perfil estratégico para o portfólio Zahil.
  • Analisar o portfólio dos clientes e apresentar os rótulos Zahil que possam se destacar e fazer a diferença, considerando "pricing" e perfil do estabelecimento.
  • Negociar a inclusão de novos rótulos, ações de visibilidade e condições comerciais.
  • Acompanhar o desempenho dos clientes (volume, mix de produtos) e propor ações para atingir as metas.
  • Transmitir à gerência as dificuldades, demandas do mercado (concorrência, preços) e oportunidades que ultrapassem sua autonomia.
  • Apoiar no uso dos sistemas internos de CRM (para gestão do funil) e de faturamento (para colocação de pedidos).

Qualificações e Experiência

  • Escolaridade: Desejável graduação completa.
  • Cursos: Curso de vinhos técnico ou de extensão (WSET, ABS, etc.) é fundamental.
  • Idiomas: Desejável inglês ou espanhol
  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de três anos em vendas B2B, com experiência comprovada no canal Off-Trade de bebidas (especialmente vinhos).
  • Networking: Um relacionamento ativo e uma carteira pré-existente será um grande diferencial.
  • Habilidades: Forte capacidade de negociação, comunicação, organização e perfil "hunter" (caçador).

Remuneração:

  • Regime CLT: R$ 4.500,00 (quatro mil e quinhentos) de salário fixo + comissão mensal
  • Benefícios: Vale Refeição/Alimentação, Vale Mobilidade e Plano médico Unimed

A Newhart Loans está expandindo seu escritório no Rio Grande do Norte e busca  profissionais de vendas bilíngues (Português/Inglês) motivados  para se juntarem à nossa equipe em crescimento. Este é um  cargo de vendas focado em relacionamento , com o objetivo de ajudar empresas nos EUA a obterem capital de giro. 

Nosso escritório opera inteiramente em inglês e oferece suporte a uma equipe de fechadores experientes nos Estados Unidos. Seu papel será  construir relacionamentos com clientes potenciais, qualificá-los e encaminhá-los para o fechamento.  

Visão Geral do Cargo  

Como  Representante de Vendas e Relacionamento , você trabalhará com  leads  (contatos) receptivos fornecidos pela empresa. Seu trabalho é conectar-se com donos de empresas, entender suas necessidades de capital de giro e guiá-los pelas fases iniciais do processo de financiamento. 

Você se comunicará principalmente via  mensagens de texto e e-mail , cultivando o relacionamento e preparando o cliente para a ligação final de fechamento com nossa equipe nos EUA. 

Principais Responsabilidades  

  • Contatar e engajar  leads fornecidos pela empresa  (donos de negócios que buscam capital). 
  • Construir relacionamentos por meio de  mensagens, e-mail e comunicação de acompanhamento ( follow-up ) . 
  • Qualificar comerciantes e entender suas  necessidades de financiamento . 
  • Coletar as informações e documentações necessárias dos clientes. 
  • Coordenar com os fechadores dos EUA,  colocando os clientes ao telefone para as ligações finais de fechamento . 
  • Manter um acompanhamento consistente para levar os acordos até a conclusão. 
  • Prestar um excelente atendimento ao cliente e manter um relacionamento profissional com os comerciantes. 

Processo de Vendas  

Um acordo típico pode ser fechado  dentro de 2 a 8 horas  assim que o comerciante engaja e avança no processo. 

As informações exigidas dos comerciantes incluem: 

  • Nome da empresa 
  • Número do Seguro Social (SSN) 
  • EIN da empresa (CNPJ americano) 
  • Data de nascimento 
  • Endereço residencial e comercial 
  • Extratos bancários comerciais dos últimos quatro meses 

Seu papel é  gerar confiança, coletar essas informações e garantir que o comerciante se conecte com nossa equipe de fechamento nos EUA.  

Remuneração  

  • Salário base R$2,071 + bônus de desempenho  
  • Comissão típica por negócio fechado:  cerca de $300 USD (além do salário)  
  • Alto potencial de ganho para vendedores motivados 
  • A estrutura de bônus está  entre as mais fortes da região  

Requisitos  

  • Inglês fluente (obrigatório)  
  • Preferência por bilíngues (Português e Inglês) 
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação e construção de relacionamentos 
  • Capacidade de realizar acompanhamento persistente e gerenciar múltiplos leads 
  • Experiência em vendas ou atendimento ao cliente é preferível 
  • Sinta-se confortável trabalhando em um  ambiente de vendas de ritmo acelerado  

Ambiente de Trabalho  

  • Cargo totalmente presencial no Rio Grande do Norte (a definir local)  
  • Sem trabalho remoto  
  • Leads, sistemas e treinamento fornecidos pela empresa 
  • Trabalho em conjunto com uma equipe focada em fechar acordos de financiamento para empresas americanas 

O Que Oferecemos  

  • Todos os leads e marketing fornecidos pela empresa 
  • Suporte total de vendas e equipe de fechamento nos Estados Unidos 
  • Processo de vendas estruturado e treinamento 
  • Ambiente de alta energia e focado em desempenho 

Se você é motivado, persistente e gosta de construir relacionamentos enquanto trabalha com vendas, este cargo oferece forte potencial de renda e oportunidades de crescimento. 

Candidatos interessados devem enviar seu currículo para  e uma breve apresentação demonstrando sua proficiência em inglês.

We are looking for a Domain Architect Operations Technology , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of Belo Horizonte - MG.

Job Description:

The Domain Architect – Operation Technology is fundamental to the architecture, governance and evolution of operational technology solutions and infrastructures in the mining operations of Brasil and Canada. This professional will lead the integration of traditional OT systems (SCADA, DCS, PLCs) with emerging technologies of industrial IoT, industrial cloud, advanced automation and OT cybersecurity.

Its mission is to ensure safe, resilient, integrated industrial operations aligned with global digital strategy, supporting innovations in mining 4.0, sustainability, operational efficiency and digital transformation. He will work collaboratively with technical, security, IT and business areas at the multinational level.

Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and govern OT architectures, ensuring alignment between industrial systems, automation, IoT sensors and integration with IT and Cloud.
  • Design solutions for real-time control, monitoring, automation and analysis of industrial processes, ensuring high availability and resilience.
  • Lead modernization projects, edge/cloud OT integration, digital twins, predictive analytics, cognitive automation, and operational security.
  • Assess and implement global OT security standards (NIST, IEC 62443), vulnerability management, and industrial cyber incident response.
  • Foster alignment between OT and IT teams to promote secure, efficient, and scalable integration of operational technologies.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, contingency plans, operational guides, and OT governance policies.
  • Participate in the definition of strategies for technological innovation, sustainability and reduction of environmental impact.
  • Collaborate with suppliers and strategic partners on critical OT solutions, ensuring system interoperability.
  • Train technical teams and promote a culture of safety and OT innovation in global operations.

Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Computing, Industrial Systems or related areas.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in architecture, engineering, or operational technology leadership in industrial or mining sectors.
  • In-depth knowledge of OT systems: SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU, IoT sensors, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, Profibus).
  • Expertise in OT/IT integration, edge computing architectures, digital twins, advanced automation, predictive analytics and Industrial Big Data.
  • Solid domain in OT cybersecurity, IEC 62443 frameworks, NIST, incident management and operational continuity.
  • Knowledge in industrial cloud platforms (Azure IoT, AWS IoT, Google Cloud Industrial) and OT modernization.
  • Experience with governance, regulatory compliance, sustainability and ESG standards in the mining and process industry.
  • Fluent English for global communication and advanced Portuguese for Brazil-Canada work.

Soft Skills

  • Technical and consultative leadership, negotiation skills and influence in multicultural and multidisciplinary environments.
  • Strategic vision to connect OT technological innovation to business, safety and sustainability.
  • Clear and effective communication to diverse stakeholders and technical and executive teams.
  • Proactivity, resilience, critical thinking and focus on sustainable and safe results.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • Technical certifications in OT (ISA/IEC 62443, Certified Automation Professional, Cybersecurity Certifications).
  • Experience with industrial digital platforms, analytics, AI/ML applied to operation.
  • Experience in operations or in large-scale mining.
  • Ability to conduct global projects with multiple teams and stakeholders.

Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Robust architecture and governance of OT solutions, supporting Brazil and Canada operations with security and innovation.
  • Leadership in OT digital transformation projects aiming at sustainability, automation and operational efficiency.
  • Support OT/IT integration, compliance, and governance of critical operations.
  • Dissemination of OT governance and global technical capacity building.
  • Increased resilience, safety and efficiency of industrial operations.

Additional Comments:

The OT Domain Architect is a key player in the technological and sustainable evolution of industrial operations, working in complex and global environments. Technical expertise, strategic vision, and collaborative capabilities are essential to strengthen technological leadership in the mining and energy sectors.

title: Technical Product Manager (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

You are a technically fluent, execution-oriented professional who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and stakeholder management. You communicate clearly, operate independently, and bring empathy to every interaction.

You are proactive and solution-oriented. You identify problems, define solutions, and drive them forward in fast-paced Agile environments. You actively leverage AI tools as part of your daily workflow to improve productivity and delivery outcomes.

You feel comfortable owning a product backlog, onboarding API partners, presenting to a Change Advisory Board, and collaborating directly with clients to troubleshoot issues. You connect teams, drive accountability, and ensure initiatives move forward successfully.

Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Strong fluency in Agile and Scrum, including backlog ownership, sprint ceremonies, user story writing, and acceptance criteria definition.
  • Strong product ownership mindset, with the ability to prioritize effectively, champion quality, and drive the Definition of Done.
  • Proven ability to act as a liaison between engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external technology partners.
  • Excellent technical communication skills, translating business requirements into technical language for audiences at all levels.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and authentication concepts, including error handling, log review, and defect triage.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, issue tracking, and release coordination.
  • Strong documentation skills covering requirements, epics, user stories, workflows, and integration touchpoints.
  • Active user of AI tools and copilots, with a practical focus on improving workflows and engineering productivity.
  • Highly self-managed, with strong ownership and proactive risk identification across concurrent initiatives.
  • Strong empathy and curiosity for customer and partner problems, with a practical and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Own and maintain a well-groomed product backlog, writing user stories and acceptance criteria aligned with business needs.
  • Lead cross-functional project delivery and serve as the team’s single point of accountability for quality and progress.
  • Act as the primary coordination point between internal engineering teams and external API or integration partners.
  • Translate business and partner requirements into clear functional and technical specifications.
  • Manage intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical issues, defects, and enhancement requests.
  • Support onboarding of API and integration partners, including requirements gathering, environment setup, testing, and go-live.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies and cross-functional working sessions with internal and external teams.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to analyze logs, error reports, and support tickets to diagnose and resolve issues.
  • Deliver weekly status reports to stakeholders covering milestones, risks, and blockers.
  • Present change requests to the Change Advisory Board (CAB).
  • Coordinate and support UAT and partner validation activities.
  • Track delivery progress, dependencies, and risks across multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Provide direct user support when required, including troubleshooting, feature walkthroughs, and discovery sessions.
  • Leverage AI tools to improve workflows, documentation quality, and delivery speed.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, support, and issue management processes through standardization and automation.

Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Jira or Azure DevOps for backlog management, sprint planning, and issue tracking.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, and integration concepts, with the ability to support partner onboarding and triage technical issues.
  • Proven ability to write user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation for cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency with conversational fluency to collaborate effectively with US-based stakeholders.

Additional Information

About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: User Insights Specialist
description:
Role Overview

The User Insights Specialist will be responsible for analyzing user behavior, identifying experience gaps, and generating insights that inform product, operations, and growth strategies.

This role combines data analytics, user research, and business understanding , requiring strong SQL capabilities and the ability to communicate insights effectively to cross-functional stakeholders.

This position requires full on-site presence (5 days per week) to enable close collaboration with Product, Operations, and Business teams.

Key Responsibilities

User Insights & Analysis

  • Analyze user behavior, engagement trends, and operational data to identify opportunities to improve user experience and retention.
  • Translate complex datasets into actionable insights supporting product and business decision-making.
  • Monitor key user metrics and proactively identify risks, friction points, and growth opportunities.

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets using SQL .
  • Build dashboards, recurring reports, and insight frameworks to track user experience performance.
  • Partner with Data, Product, and Operations teams to define and monitor KPIs related to user satisfaction and platform performance.

User Research & Feedback Integration

  • Consolidate quantitative data with qualitative user feedback (surveys, interviews, support data, NPS).
  • Identify root causes behind user pain points and behavioral patterns.
  • Support experimentation initiatives by measuring impact and validating hypotheses.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Operations, Customer Experience, and Growth teams to influence strategic decisions.
  • Present insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Drive a data-informed culture by promoting user-centric decision-making.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Analytics, Economics, Statistics, or related field.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction and analysis.
  • Professional fluency in English and Portuguese (written and spoken).
  • Experience working with data analytics, user insights, product analytics, or business intelligence.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to translate data into clear business recommendations.
  • Willingness to work on-site in the office 5 days per week .

title: Customer Success Manager (Account) for LATAM Region
description:
Company Description

Ailet is a leading innovator in enhancing retail efficiency for the FMCG, Retail, and Pharma sectors by leveraging advanced technologies such as computer vision, image recognition, big data analytics, and mobile solutions. Our offerings enable real-time monitoring of merchandise displays, competitive landscapes, and operational in-store audits with a remarkable image recognition accuracy of 95%+. We specialize in digital merchandising, retail execution, OSA control, and price and promotional tracking. Ailet serves global brands across Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), Retail, and Pharma industries.

What our Customer Success Manager will do:

  • Account management:

* Become customer’s advocate & escalation point;

* Build relationships and collect feedback regularly;

* Ensure service is provided at sufficient level of quality;

* Manage relationships with all partners involved;

* Orchestrate overall billing and payments.

  • Customer Success:

* Know customer’s processes and KPIs;

* Make sure Ailet solution drives customer’s operational excellence;

* Conduct benchmarking analysis among trusted pool of clients;

* Consult customers on best-in-class processes and latest IR use-cases;

* Catch market trends and share it with Ailet R&D team (product managers);

* Conduct business review meetings with customers, obtain data for case-studies.

  • Farming:

* Grow MRR through up-sell and cross-sell potential;

* Build yearly revenue plan for each entrusted customer and execute it;

* Ensure benchmarking level of customers retention;

* Maintain NRR (Net Revenue Retention) KPI at a strongly positive level.

  • Who we’re looking for:

* English, Spanish, Portuguese speaking/writing at B2+ is a must;

* Based in Sao Paulo or nearby;

* Experience in CSM role in the field of FMCG, Retail up to 2 years;

* Excellent verbal & written presentation and project management, creating projects analytics, interaction with all levels both internally and externally.

* Experience in the creation of a sales plan and its implementation;

* Experience in developing, implementing and conducting customer surveys (NPS). Processing the results of surveys on product satisfaction (C-Sat);

* Management experience.

  • Nice to have:

* Experience with Enterprise clients;

* Technical background;

* Experience working in companies like GFK, Nielson, Envolves or Retailers like Wallmart, Carrefour;

* 2+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales and marketing.

  • Terms of cooperation:

* Monthly income & semi annual bonuses for achieving targets;

* Five day work week, full time and long-term commitment;

* Freelance contract based;

* Report to Latam Sales Director in Mexico;

* Work on international projects with multicultural teams using the most modern technologies;

* Professional development: inside Ailet Product courses and corporate Performance Reviews;

* Foreign language classes compensation (English, Spanish, Portuguese etc.);

* The ability to work remotely in the Sao Paulo Area.

We are interested in candidates from Brazil and based in Sao Paulo Area. 

If you think that the above meets your expectations and you meet our expectations, then send your C V in English as soon as possible.

title: Senior Ecosystem Growth Manager
description:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

We’re building the next phase of real-world adoption on the XRP Ledger, and LATAM is a critical part of that journey. As Senior Ecosystem Growth Manager for LATAM, you’ll partner with builders, founders, and institutions to expand how tokenized assets are used across payments, trade finance, and collateral management.

Together, we’ll grow a durable ecosystem by connecting startups, venture capital, and strategic partners across LATAM’s FinTech and TradFi landscape, while navigating the region’s diverse regulatory environments. This is a strategic yet hands-on role blending ecosystem development, partnerships, and go-to-market execution.

You will be responsible for the rollout of ecosystem growth programs, supporting emerging startups from inception to mainnet launch, and improving our standing in the region. Navigating LATAM’s diverse regulatory landscape, you will form a robust network of startup programs, venture capital firms, and ecosystem players.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Complete and put into action ecosystem growth strategy for XRPL, adapted to local regulatory and market conditions
  • Discover, evaluate, and support high-potential startups and developers building on XRPL
  • Build meaningful alliances with accelerators, VCs, FinTech, and ecosystem service providers
  • Structure partnership agreements built to drive balanced ecosystem growth
  • Guide startups from early-stage concept through successful mainnet deployment
  • Review grant and accelerator applications, assessing founder quality, product potential, and ecosystem fit
  • Facilitate introductions to partners, resources, and growth opportunities
  • Provide ongoing support to portfolio companies to help accelerate their growth trajectory
  • Build and lead top-of-funnel pipelines through targeted programs, grants, and direct outreach, while identifying emerging trends, new growth partners, and institutional channels across LATAM
  • Work closely with DevRel, Partner Engineering, Product, and Product Marketing, you’ll help shape go-to-market strategies & iterate based on ecosystem performance and market feedback
  • Supervise regulatory developments and assess their impact on tokenization and digital asset adoption
  • Use data and strategic narratives to influence cross-functional collaborators
  • Pressure-test growth strategies and provide thoughtful tradeoff analysis across challenging priorities
  • Anticipate market obstacles and recommend scalable, innovative solutions

WHAT YOU'LL BRING: 

  • 5–8 years in venture capital, ecosystem partnerships, FinTech or TradFi growth, or related roles
  • Proven track record in structuring and leading partnerships with early-stage teams or strategic collaborators
  • Experience operating across markets with diverse regulatory and business environments
  • Strong growth and metrics fluency, including funnel optimization and partnership performance benchmarking
  • Technical understanding sufficient to engage product and infrastructure teams on feasibility assessments
  • Solid understanding of financial instruments, market structure, and regulatory frameworks
  • Familiarity with tokenization trends, DeFi protocols, and their intersection with traditional finance
  • Clear, influential communicator with strong relationship-building skills
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity with autonomy and accountability
  • Data-guided approach to measuring and improving ecosystem growth initiatives 

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
  • In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in. 
  • Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
  • We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

  • Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
  • Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
  • Employee giving match
  • Mobile phone stipend

Take Care of Yourself

  • R&R days so you can rest and recharge
  • Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
  • Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
  • Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
  • Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.

title: Analista de marketing digital
description:
IMPORTANTE

Esta vaga é para:

  • Analista de Performance & Marketing Ops (Pleno)

(Título no LinkedIn ajustado para “Analista de Marketing Digital”)

Esta vaga não é para:

  • Inbound, SEO, Branding ou Social Media
  • Gestão de tráfego focada apenas em cliques, leads ou CPL

Em B2B, a venda não acontece no formulário. Acontece no CRM, portanto:

  • Se você otimiza por receita, vamos conversar.

Função: Analista de Performance e Marketing Ops

Nível: Pleno

Na SoulRocket, acreditamos que campanhas de alta performance dependem de dados bem estruturados, tracking correto e integrações entre sistemas.

Buscamos um Analista de Performance e Marketing Ops Pleno para estruturar a infraestrutura de dados que permite que campanhas de marketing digital sejam otimizadas com base em eventos reais do funil de vendas.

Esta vaga é diferente de uma função tradicional de gestor de tráfego focada apenas em eventos de navegação. Em campanhas para empresas B2B de médio e grande porte, a jornada do lead até a venda acontece principalmente dentro do CRM, passando por etapas de qualificação, interações com vendedores e negociações.

Por isso, as campanhas só podem ser realmente otimizadas quando recebem dados reais do CRM por meio de integrações, e não apenas eventos superficiais como visitas ou envio de formulários.

• Implementar tracking com GTM e GA4

• Criar integrações entre CRM, automação, Ads e analytics

• Garantir que dados de conversão alimentem a otimização das campanhas

Requisitos principais

• Experiência com GTM, GA4 e eventos de conversão

• Experiência com CRM e automação (RD Station, HubSpot, GHL)

• Experiência com campanhas de performance

• Conhecimento em integrações (Zapier, Make, Webhooks ou APIs)

Contrato PJ

Observação:

Esta vaga exige experiência em tracking, integrações e CRM.

Perfis focados apenas em gestão de tráfego podem não se encaixar.

description:

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

Ei #fera em salesforce, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um(a) #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

  • Administração e configuração do Salesforce CRM, com atuação em Lightning Applications e desenvolvimento de páginas e componentes (Lightning), além da implementação de Workflows, Approvals, Flows, Reports e Dashboards. Atuação em atividades de Admin, Admin Advanced, App Builder e consultoria.
  • Utilização de ferramentas da plataforma Force.com , incluindo Force.com Explorer, Change Sets, Import Wizard e Excel Connector, com operação em ambientes Sandbox e Production, além do uso de Visual Studio, IntelliJ e Salesforce Inspector.
  • Execução de rotinas de integração e manipulação de dados com Apex Data Loader, Import Wizard, Data Export e Mass Delete, bem como validação de integrações via Postman. Aplicação de consultas e extrações de dados utilizando SQL, SOQL e SOSL .
  • Certificações Salesforce: mandatório Administrator e Platform App Builder ; desejável Service Cloud Consultant, Sales Cloud Consultant, Experience Cloud Consultant e Advanced Administrator.
  • Inglês avançado para atuar em time Global.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

title: Consultor Planejamento Pl
description:
Junte-se ao Grupo CPFL e Potencialize Sua Carreira!

Consultor Planejamento Pl.

Onde você vai atuar: Campinas/SP ou São José do Rio Pardo/SP.

Modelo de trabalho: Presencial

Empresa: CPFL Serviços – Uma empresa do Grupo CPFL Energia.

Pré-Requisitos:

  • Necessário Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Necessário Excel intermediário/avançado;
  • Experiência com planejamento de obras de subestação e linhas de transmissão;
  • Desejável experiência com softwares de planejamento (MS Project, Primavera;
  • Desejável experiência com Power BI;
  • Desejável experiência com planejamento orçamentário, forecast e acompanhamento de performance;
  • Desejável CNH B;
  • Desejável experiência com atividades administrativas ou de análises;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho 100% presencial em São José do Rio Pardo/SP.

O seu dia a dia:

  • Elaborar histogramas de recursos (pessoas, equipamentos e materiais) com base nas demandas de cada obra, contribuindo para a composição orçamentária e a alocação eficiente dos recursos;
  • Construir e atualizar cronogramas físicos das obras a partir da análise de dados técnicos, garantindo o controle dos prazos e o alinhamento com os objetivos do projeto;
  • Desenvolver e manter curvas S e relatórios de acompanhamento para apoiar o monitoramento da evolução física e financeira das obras;
  • Elaborar, acompanhar e revisar orçamentos de obras, consolidando informações técnicas e financeiras para garantir a acurácia e a aderência às metas corporativas;
  • Realizar análises financeiras e operacionais para identificar desvios, riscos e oportunidades, suportando decisões estratégicas da liderança;
  • Consolidar e interpretar dados de múltiplas áreas, transformando informações técnicas e financeiras em relatórios gerenciais estruturados e objetivos;
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs – Key Performance Indicators) e propor ajustes nos planos e metas para assegurar o cumprimento dos objetivos estratégicos;
  • Contribuir na construção de modelos de planejamento e simulação de cenários, participando do desenvolvimento de projeções de curto, médio e longo prazos;
  • Apoiar o desdobramento de metas e objetivos, garantindo coerência entre os planos operacionais e a estratégia organizacional;
  • Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de finanças, controladoria, operações e comercial para promover consistência e integração entre os dados e os planos corporativos;
  • Colaborar na melhoria contínua de processos, ferramentas e sistemas de planejamento, propondo automatizações e otimizações que aumentem a eficiência das entregas;
  • Preparar apresentações executivas para comitês e diretoria, consolidando dados, análises e recomendações em materiais objetivos e estratégicos;
  • Apoiar projetos estratégicos ou corporativos, conduzindo análises, acompanhando cronogramas e controlando entregas para garantir o atingimento dos resultados esperados.

O que oferecemos:

  • Vale Transporte;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Licença maternidade 6 meses e paternidade 20 dias
  • Auxílio creche (conforme regras de elegibilidade);
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • PLR;
  • Gympass;
  • Programa Fale Comigo (assessoria gratuita e sigilosa via telefone para auxílio psicológico, jurídico, financeiro, social).

Conheça um pouco sobre nós:

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a skilled Data Engineer to design, develop, and deliver high‑quality DW/BI solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong SQL expertise, hands-on experience with ETL processes, and a solid understanding of data governance, data quality, and metadata management. This role requires strong analytical capabilities, communication skills, and the ability to work independently while managing priorities effectively.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver end-to-end Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence solutions, ensuring quality, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Work across multiple DW/BI disciplines including ETL, data access control, data quality, metadata management, and data governance.
  • Develop complex SQL queries for data analysis, transformation, and validation.
  • Build and maintain ETL pipelines using ETL tools or programming languages.
  • Participate in requirement gathering, analysis, and documentation for BI projects.
  • Prioritize tasks effectively and manage project timelines, deliverables, and resources.
  • Support dashboard and data visualization initiatives using tools such as Tableau, QlikView, or Google’s PLX Dashboard.
  • Contribute to the improvement of DW/BI best practices, development standards, and data quality processes.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Experience delivering Data Warehouse and Business Intelligence solutions.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced queries and data manipulation.
  • Experience developing ETL processes or data pipelines using ETL tools or programming languages.
  • Familiarity with SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) and structured development methodologies.
  • Excellent communication skills, including advanced English proficiency.
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Pentaho for ETL development.
  • Programming/scripting experience with Python, Shell scripting, and/or JavaScript.
  • Experience with visualization and reporting tools such as Tableau, QlikView, or Google PLX Dashboard.
  • Experience with BI requirements gathering and functional analysis.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Detail‑oriented with a strong focus on data quality.
  • Able to work independently and manage competing priorities.
  • Strong communicator capable of working with cross-functional teams.
  • A proactive problem solver with a passion for data and process optimization.

Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

  • Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: 26011301 Business Analyst - FX Markets
description:
Business Analyst – FX Markets

Location: Sao Paolo

Area: Corporate & Investment Banking / Global Markets/FX

Languages: Fluent English (please share CV in English)

About the Role

We are looking for a Business Analyst with experience in FX Markets to join our team and contribute to the design and delivery of key initiatives across pricing, trading, eFX, and post-trade workflows. This role is ideal for someone with strong analytical capabilities, a solid understanding of FX products, and experience defining functional and API requirements in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.

What You Will Be Doing

As a Business Analyst in the FX Technology & Change team, your responsibilities will include:

Requirements & Functional Analysis

  • Collect and document business requirements across FX trading, pricing, liquidity, and market connectivity.
  • Translate business needs into clear functional specifications , user stories , and acceptance criteria .
  • Define and maintain API specifications (data models, message structures, integration logic).
  • Map end-to-end processes and identify improvement opportunities aligned with digital transformation strategy.

Project Delivery & Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work closely with Front Office, Middle Office, Product Owners, Architecture, and Technology teams.
  • Contribute to test planning, clarify requirements for QA teams, and support UAT activities.
  • Collaborate effectively across a global organization, ensuring alignment with CIB standards and governance.

Documentation & Tools

  • Produce high-quality documentation using Jira and Confluence , ensuring traceability and auditability.
  • Apply AI tools to streamline analysis, documentation, and communication tasks.
  • Maintain clear and concise functional artefacts consistent with internal guidelines.

What We Are Looking For

Required Experience & Skills

  • At least 3 years of experience in FX Markets (spot, forwards, swaps, NDFs, or eFX).
  • Proven experience defining API requirements and working with integration teams.
  • Medium-level proficiency with Jira and Confluence .
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate complex topics in a clear and structured manner.
  • Ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with multiple stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in electronic trading platforms, market connectivity, or algo trading.
  • Experience using AI-based productivity tools in daily workflows (ChatGPT, Rovo)
  • Understanding of regulatory frameworks impacting FX (e.g., MiFID II).
  • Familiarity with Agile delivery models within financial services.
  • Knowledge of SQL or Python for data validation is a plus.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to contribute to key transformation initiatives within Global Markets business.
  • A collaborative and diverse working environment with global exposure.
  • Professional growth and learning opportunities through CIB programs and digital skills development.
  • The chance to work with cutting-edge technology and innovative market solutions.

title: Planejador de Manutenção
description:
Visão Geral da Vaga

O Planejador(a) de Manutenção é responsável por estruturar, programar e controlar as atividades de manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva, assegurando a disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos ativos industriais. Atua como elo estratégico entre as equipes de manutenção, suprimentos e produção, garantindo o uso eficiente de recursos, o cumprimento dos planos estabelecidos e a melhoria contínua dos equipamentos e processos.

Atribuições

  • Desenvolver e revisar planos de manutenção preventiva e preditiva com base em históricos, manuais técnicos e recomendações dos fabricantes.
  • Programar paradas de manutenção e apoiar o planejamento de shutdowns em parceria com as áreas operacionais.
  • Emitir, acompanhar e controlar ordens de serviço no sistema de gestão de manutenção (ex.: SAP).

consumo de materiais/serviços e demais despesas envolvidas em suas atividades.

Operações e Obras.

A BRK é uma das maiores empresas privadas de saneamento do país e está presente em 13 estados e mais de 100 municípios, beneficiando a vida de mais de 16 milhões de pessoas.

Investimos e operamos sistemas de água e esgoto, fornecendo um serviço que faz toda a diferença para a saúde e o bem-estar da população.

title: QA Engineer
description:
Senior QA Engineer

Location: Remote (Brazil. Based)

Reports to: QA Engineer Senior

Type: Full-time

Salary : Competitive open to negotiate payment USD

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to join our growing technology team for an important Fintech Crypto Company. This role is crucial in ensuring the quality, performance, and reliability of our software products.

You will be responsible for executing manual and automated tests, identifying and documenting issues, and creating test scenarios aligned with business and technical requirements. You’ll also contribute to improving QA processes, CI/CD integration, and leveraging AI technologies to enhance automation efficiency and coverage.

This is a hands-on position — ideal for someone who enjoys both technical testing and process improvement , and who thrives in a collaborative, Agile environment.

⚙️ Key Responsibilities

  • Execute manual and automated tests to ensure software quality and performance.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases based on business requirements.
  • Create and manage functional and regression tests across multiple platforms.
  • Identify, document, and track issues and inconsistencies; collaborate with developers for timely resolution.
  • Support and promote best quality assurance practices within the development team.
  • Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline to support continuous delivery.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve QA processes, tools, and methodologies .
  • Provide clear reporting on testing progress, risks, and software quality metrics.
  • Utilize AI-based tools to enhance test creation, automation scripting, and defect detection.
  • Collaborate closely with product owners, developers, and stakeholders to ensure alignment with user expectations.

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Experience

  • 4+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, with 2+ years in automation testing.
  • Proven experience in manual and automated testing within an Agile environment.
  • Strong background in designing and executing detailed test plans and defect management .
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD workflows .

Technical Skills

  • Advanced English level ( C1 ).
  • Proficiency with testing frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright .
  • Familiarity with AI tools for generating or optimizing test scripts.
  • Experience with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner).
  • Understanding of REST APIs, SQL , and general software testing methodologies.
  • Knowledge of Agile/Scrum practices and ability to collaborate in iterative development cycles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Playwright .
  • Exposure to AI-based test automation or intelligent test generation tools.
  • Experience with cloud-based environments and microservices testing.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tools .

Why Join Us

  • Work with cutting-edge QA and AI technologies in a fast-paced environment.
  • Join a collaborative, innovation-driven engineering culture .
  • Competitive compensation and long-term growth opportunities .
  • Opportunity to contribute to high-impact, scalable software solutions .

title: Projetista Industrial PL
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um Projetista PL para atuar no time da Indústria.

Quais as responsabilidades?

  • Elaboração de projetos para instalação de linha de vida ;
  • Desenvolvimento de memoriais descritivos e documentação técnica;
  • Elaboração de listas de materiais ;
  • Preparação de estimativas de custos ;
  • Desenvolvimento de fluxogramas de processo e P&ID ;
  • Realização de cálculos de bombeamento ;
  • Execução de cálculos estruturais e análises de tensão/deformação ;
  • Levantamento de campo e coleta de dados para desenvolvimento de projetos;
  • Apoio técnico nas fases de planejamento, execução e acompanhamento de obras;
  • Equalização técnica de propostas comerciais e orçamentos para atividades na planta.

Quais os requisitos?

  • Formação técnica em Mecânica ou graduação em Engenharia Mecânica, Civil, Elétrica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada na elaboração e detalhamento de projetos industriais;
  • Conhecimento nos softwares: AutoCAD Plant 3D, Inventor e Pipe Flow.

Qual localidade?

  • Unidade São José | Colina SP

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Retail Operations Manager - Sao Paulo
description:
The Retail Operations Manager is the in‑market Brand Expert responsible for supporting franchise partners across multiple countries and regions. This role ensures that global strategies are translated into consistent, high‑quality execution in diverse cultural, commercial, and operational environments. Operating as the brand owner’s representative in‑market, the Retail Operations Manager partners closely with franchise Field Leadership Teams to drive sales growth, elevate customer experience, uphold brand standards, and build long‑term capability across a portfolio of international markets. They serve as the critical connector between global strategy, regional priorities, and the customer experience delivered in stores across countries.

Responsibilities:

Grow & Drive Business: Deliver consistent sales growth across multiple countries

  • Influence sales performance across a portfolio of international markets by leveraging business analysis and optimizing KPIs unique to each country.
  • Align with the Regional Commercial Manager and franchise partners across regions on action plans from Weekly Business Reviews, integrating weekly sales results by country, category, and store.
  • Provide market‑specific insights and seasonal hindsight to International and Regional Commercial teams, highlighting differences in consumer behavior, competitive dynamics, and promotional effectiveness across countries.
  • Create customer intimacy through time spent in stores across diverse markets, reinforcing training tools and demonstrating how to foster a customer‑centric culture adapted to local norms.
  • Ensure brand standards are consistently upheld across countries, incorporating cultural and operational differences; review daily store photos from multiple markets and partner with franchise leaders to drive follow‑up actions.
  • Build a disciplined, execution‑focused culture across all assigned markets, identifying cross‑country opportunities and sharing best practices across regions.

Capability: Drive operational excellence across varied market environments

  • Support partners in new store openings across different countries, ensuring consistent brand standards despite varying local regulations, labor practices, and operational models.
  • Escalate critical issues impacting performance in any market and collaborate with the Regional Commercial Manager and global teams to remove obstacles, expedite solutions, and ensure operational excellence across regions.

Talent & Culture: Build capability across diverse franchise leadership teams

  • Participate in talent recruitment and succession planning across multiple countries, understanding differences in talent pools, leadership norms, and labor markets.
  • Assess strengths and gaps in franchise Field Leadership Teams across regions; influence partner actions to address capability gaps in each market.
  • Coach and train partner leaders across countries to deliver a consistent, branded customer experience while adapting to local cultural expectations and customer behaviors.
  • Conduct regular store visits across markets, providing in‑store coaching, behavior modeling, and follow‑up to ensure consistent execution of the selling model and visual standards internationally.

Partnerships: Strengthen relationships across international franchise partners

  • Provide timely communication and participate in weekly and monthly business reviews across multiple countries, ensuring alignment with global and regional priorities.
  • Cascade information across markets, ensuring franchise partners in each country are informed and prepared to execute customer‑facing brand activities, initiatives, and strategies.

Why This Role Matters

The Retail Operations Manager is the in-market brand guardian, ensuring that global strategies translate into flawless store execution and exceptional customer experiences. By coaching and developing franchise field and store leaders, they influence sales growth, uphold brand standards, and build sustainable capability in-market. This role also strengthens franchise partnerships by providing insights, escalating issues, and ensuring operational excellence The Retail Operations Manager is the critical connector between global strategy and the customer experience in stores.

The ROM is unique because, while their in-market peers are employed by the franchise partner , they themselves represent the brand owner . They partner with the FLT/SLT, but with a mandate to coach, influence, and escalate back to the Regional Commercial Manager and global teams.

Qualifications & Experience

The job requires a background of 5 to 7 years in Retail Operations/Field Management, with a preference for experience in Franchise (partner) operations or managing multiple store locations.

  • Previous experience in fashion/beauty highly desired
  • Proven record in talent development and influence
  • Ability to quickly analyze key business metrics and results to identify performance improvement opportunities and recommend meaningful solutions
  • Capable of fostering customer closeness through a keen understanding of brand and customer awareness
  • Proficient communication abilities and the skill to cultivate successful business relationships
  • Proficiency in engaging with diverse levels, functions, and cultures to develop positive relationships
  • Capability to collaborate with Senior level management
  • Ability to recognize when to be hands-on and when to step back and take a mentoring role
  • Ability to communicate, influence, and negotiate effectively
  • Established track record of strong organizational abilities, skilled at handling diverse responsibilities with conflicting priorities, and effectively managing time
  • Should possess the skill to identify possibilities and promptly translate them into suggestions
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint)
  • Ability to travel up to 50%

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience required

Core Competencies

  • Lead with Curiosity & Humility
  • Build High Performing Teams for Today & Tomorrow
  • Influence & Inspire with Vision & Purpose
  • Observe, Engage & Connect
  • Strive to Achieve Operational Excellence
  • Deliver Business Results

title: Master Data Analyst
description:
Join our IT Master Data team and contribute to the reliability, integrity, and consistency of master data supporting the new Brazil operating model. As a Master Data Support Analyst, you will provide functional and technical Level 2 support on the Master Data Management (MDM) platform, focusing on maintaining referential data objects using the EBX tool and associated middleware layers. You will act as a key liaison between global MDM teams, shared services centers, and Brazil-based business stakeholders, ensuring compliance with corporate and local Data Governance rules and standards. In addition to Level 2 support, you will participate in operational data quality initiatives, continuous improvement efforts, and user training, collaborating across departments to support efficient business operations and sustained data excellence. Service is provided in English.

Your missions:

  • Investigate and resolve master data integration issues by conducting detailed root cause analysis and implementing effective corrective and preventive actions.
  • Monitor overall data quality health and proactively propose, plan, and coordinate data cleansing campaigns aligned with Brazil-specific business rules and global data standards.
  • Perform advanced Level 2 troubleshooting, including middleware log analysis, payload simulation (SOAP UI, Postman), SQL querying, XML/JSON interpretation, and support of infrastructure operations when required.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for the EBX platform, providing guidance on configuration changes, enhancements, testing activities, and local customizations supporting the Brazil business model.
  • Enforce Data Governance rules and standards to ensure master data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems and functional domains.
  • Contribute to Non‑Regression Testing (NRT) campaigns, functional and integration testing, and continuous improvement initiatives linked to MDM processes and tooling.
  • Maintain, enhance, and document user guides, runbooks, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs); actively participate in or deliver training sessions to promote best practices and user adoption.
  • Provide regular reporting on issue status, data quality metrics, cleansing campaigns, and project progress to the Service Delivery Manager and relevant stakeholders.
  • Collaborate closely with key users across Accounting, Trading, Credit, and other business domains to understand requirements and translate them into scalable, compliant MDM solutions aligned with Brazil’s business strategy.
  • Interface effectively with Level 1 support teams, global MDM leads, IT teams, and outsourced partners to ensure smooth operations, timely issue resolution, and high‑quality service delivery.

Your profile:

  • Solid background in Master Data Management, data quality, or user support.
  • Strong understanding of Master Data Management (MDM) concepts.
  • Familiarity with middleware tools, SOAP UI, Postman, SQL, XML, and JSON troubleshooting.
  • Proven ability to analyze complex issues and synthesize actionable insights.
  • Academic background: supply chain management, logistics, business administration, finance, or equivalent.
  • English fluent. Portuguese is a plus.
  • Knowledge of SDLC of an application.
  • Awareness of Brazil-specific regulatory, tax, and data protection requirements and ability to apply them to MDM practices.
  • Experience with API testing tools (SOAP UI, Postman) for payload simulation and testing.
  • Experience running and analyzing SQL queries.
  • Experience reading and interpreting XML and JSON files.
  • Experience with MDM platforms and tools.
  • Familiarity with monitoring logs and data flow in middleware and integration layers.
  • Experience with ITSM platforms such as Jira, ServiceNow (SNOW), or similar for incident and problem management.
  • Experience with MS Tools and manipulating and analyzing data with Excel.
  • You demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, excellent communication skills, a self-driven and customer-focused attitude, agility in learning, sound decision-making capabilities, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team. Flexibility to adapt to tight deadlines and a strong cross-cultural mindset for effective collaboration with global teams. Willingness to travel if necessary.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Serviços - RJ
description:
Resumo do cargo:

Proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

1) Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sistemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);

2) Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas , diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;

3) Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;

4) Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;

5) Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);

6) Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);

7) Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);

8) Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, assim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;

9) Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.

Quem você é:

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
  • Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Yeah, you heard that right.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.

  • Strong experience as a graphic designer, with a portfolio showcasing your skills in visual design, creativity, and problem-solving.

  • Familiarity with AI-powered design tools (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Nanobanana, Midjourney, Firefly, Freepik AI, Claude, etc.) and an eagerness to explore new AI technologies.

  • Ability to work efficiently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple design projects simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with team members.
  • A working level of written and spoken English

Our operating hours are 9 A.M. to 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação, capaz de articular bugs complexos, resultados de testes e preocupações de qualidade de forma clara e objetiva para o time e cliente.
  • Capacidade de agir de forma antecipada na identificação de riscos de qualidade no início do ciclo de desenvolvimento, sugerindo melhorias contínuas nos processos de QA.
  • Organização para gerenciar e priorizar múltiplas demandas, testes e bugs simultaneamente, mantendo a documentação e os status atualizados.
